PP_AimPrecTip: Changes how fast the right stick turns while you aim (L2) and while you aim and shoot (L2 + R2). It never moves the aim on its own.
PP_AimPrecNote: 100 % = normal. Lower = slower and more precise aim; higher = faster. It never moves the aim on its own: you stay in control.
